# 元冰可 · Enterprise AI Resource Management Platform

> **v1.5.0 · MIT · self-hosted.** One control plane for every MCP server, skill, agent and AI app.

**Unify the MCP services / Skills / Agents / AI apps / model channels / SaaS connectors / NAS storage scattered across an enterprise into a single set of assets that can be managed, measured, and audited.**

One identity · one permission model · one metering system · one audit trail. **29 plugin packages, enabled on demand.**

> **YBK Enterprise AI Asset Governance** — One control plane for every MCP server, skill,
> agent, and AI app. One identity, one permission model, one metering pipeline, one audit trail.
> Self-hosted, MIT licensed.

**[▶ Try the live demo without logging in](https://demo.ybkkasi.com)** · **[⬇ Start locally in 60 seconds](#60-秒跑起来)** · **[📖 Docs](https://github.com/01men/ybkkasi/blob/HEAD/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)**

---

## Symptoms you may be experiencing

- MCP services are scattered everywhere, and **nobody can say who is using them**
- Agents charge around with a single **all-powerful token**
- The model bill arrives at month-end, and **nobody can say which department spent it**
- When a data problem occurs, **you search through logs and find no audit record**

元冰可 turns all of these into managed 'assets', **putting them on a governance track from the moment they are registered**.

---

## How this differs from an AI Gateway

A gateway treats MCP as 'a type of traffic to be routed'; 元冰可 treats MCP / Skill / Agent as **'assets whose lifecycle must be governed'**: with a state machine, an approval workflow, per-tool least-privilege permission declarations, and cost reports broken down by department, Agent, and Skill.

| LLMOps observability | Langfuse · LangSmith · Braintrust | Not competing; complementary (we lack trace depth) |

AnLifeX/CodexDesktop-Rebuild.body:
# Codex Desktop Rebuild

An unofficial project that rebuilds and enhances the official OpenAI Codex Desktop installer. It provides Windows builds, automatic updates, and local build support for macOS and Linux.

- Repository: [AnLifeX/CodexDesktop-Rebuild](https://github.com/AnLifeX/CodexDesktop-Rebuild)
- Download: [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/AnLifeX/CodexDesktop-Rebuild/releases/latest)
- Windows update source: [windows-update-feed](https://github.com/AnLifeX/CodexDesktop-Rebuild/releases/tag/windows-update-feed)

## Core Optimizations

- **Standalone Windows auto-update**: Uses this repository's own update source, with resumable downloads, download verification, and proxy acceleration.
- **Smart residual updates**: Plans the complete residual chain during the query phase. It is used only if the chain is complete and its total size is smaller than the full package; otherwise the full package is selected directly.
- **Chinese localization**: Enables the Chinese interface, fills in missing translations, and translates native menus and hard-coded titles.
- **Windows 10 compatibility**: Fixes compatibility issues with the Computer Use screenshot interface and provides a screenshot fallback.
- **Client feature enhancements**: Improves the local availability checks for Fast mode, plugins, the built-in browser, and Computer Use.
- **Session management compatibility**: Prefers the upstream native session deletion capability, adds an entry point only for older versions that lack archive deletion, and fixes the issue of old local sessions being hidden.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This project is not an official OpenAI release and is not affiliated with OpenAI. The build process downloads official application resources and the official Codex CLI, then patches the desktop code and repackages it. The project does not grant accounts any additional cloud permissions, model permissions, or quota.

## Project Positioning

This project tries to follow new versions of the official Codex Desktop rather than reimplementing the entire client. Instead, it builds on the official resources to:

1. Sync and unpack the official application.
2. Apply this project's patches through strict structure matching.
3. Repackage the result into artifacts suitable for the target platform.
4. Run post-build verification on the patched output, so that upstream structural changes do not silently produce a faulty installer.
5. Build, verify, and publish new Windows versions automatically through GitHub Actions.

## Main Changes from the Official Version

### Chinese Localization

- Forces the application's built-in internationalization feature on, so that remote feature flags cannot disable the Chinese interface.
- Adds Chinese copy missing from the official `zh-CN` language pack and corrects confirmed mistranslations.
- Translates Electron native menus, context menus, command menus, and some hard-coded titles…

# HIMI Sync Watch

**HIMI — Cross-platform Emby Client**

Full-platform Emby media library client · Multiple playback engines · Danmaku · Synchronized group watching · TV mode

---

## Project Overview

HIMI is essentially a cross-platform **[Flutter](https://flutter.dev)** client for **[Emby](https://emby.media)**, covering Android / iOS / Windows / Android TV / HarmonyOS. Its core capability is a complete Emby media library experience: sign-in, browsing, search, favorites, episode selection, and multi-route playback, along with localized high-quality decoding (multiple playback engines, full-chain HDR, native bitmap subtitles/PGS, low-latency startup). Remote group sync watch rooms, danmaku, liquid glass UI, and similar features are only additional enhancements.

## Core Features

| Feature | Description |
|------|------|
| **Emby Media Library** | Sign-in, browsing, search, favorites, detail pages, episode selection, playback routes |
| **High-Quality Playback** | Three playback engines, full-chain HDR, native bitmap subtitles/PGS, low-latency startup |
| **Multi-User Sync Rooms** | Join via room code / QR code scan, playback controls synced for all members (optional feature) |
| **Danmaku** | Compatible with the [弹弹 Play](https://www.dandanplay.com) protocol (no signature required), timeline matching + local cache |
| **Multiple Playback Engines** | [MDK（fvp）](https://github.com/wang-bin/fvp) / [media_kit](https://github.com/media-kit/media-kit) (libmpv) / [Erika](https://github.com/AimesSoft/Erika) (Rust core, HDR10 + native bitmap subtitles/PGS) |
| **TV Mode** | Android TV remote focus navigation, top horizontal navigation bar, supports MDK / Erika / Media Kit |
| **Liquid Glass UI** | Real refraction shader with adjustable parameters (intensity / refractive index / dispersion), based on [liquid_glass_widgets](https://github.com/sdegenaar/liquid_glass_widgets) |
| **Multiple Icon Sets** | Default / Art / Glass / Neon, switchable at runtime |

## Platform Support

| Platform | Minimum Requirement | Default Engine | Optional Engines |

## What it does

A NovelAI image stores the prompt, each character, the negative prompt, and all parameters from when it was made. NovelAI Prompt Studio reads them out so you can understand, organize, and edit them locally, then generate a new version with your own NovelAI account. Where each version came from and what changed are recorded automatically, and generated images go into the image library automatically.

| Read | Organize | Generate | Keep |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drag in, paste, or open a file; recognizes V4, V4.5, V5 | Prompts shown in blocks; text can be edited directly, like on a webpage | Start from this image's parameters and know the cost before generating | Generated images go into the image library automatically, one group per work |
| Separates what you wrote yourself from what NovelAI added automatically | Over 50,000 built-in Chinese translations for offline translation and categorization | Queues, random pools, inpainting, outpainting, director tools | Search, filter, favorite collections, export and share original images |

**Human and Agent entry points.** Every capability is a single command: you use it in the UI, and agents like Claude Code and Codex use the same set through the command-line tool `nai-studio`. Generations initiated by an agent require your confirmation before they are sent, by default.

## Images made with it

The 24 images below were all generated in the app with V5, and the characters are original. The originals are in [`demo/images/showcase`](https://github.com/LBEILC/NovelAIPromptStudio/blob/HEAD/demo/images/showcase). The prompts, characters, and parameters are still embedded in the images: download one and drag it into the app to see how it was written.

**Morning Bakery**

**Observatory Night**

**Rainy Season Flower Umbrella Street**

**Summer Aquarium**

**Snowy Small Station**

**Neon Rooftop**

## Change it and generate; every version is recorded

After editing a prompt, click "Generate" and the new version appears in the version bar, noting what changed from the previous one. Going back to an older version and continuing to edit automatically creates a new branch. You can keep queuing while generating. Random pools draw an artist string or action separately for each image, so generating 20 images gives 20 combinations.

## Edit images without leaving the app

A row of actions sits below each image: upscale, enhance, inpainting, outpainting, plus director tools like background removal, colorization, and expression change. Each one shows its size and price upfront. The result is a new version that you can compare side by side or overlay with the previous one.

## Image library: find prompts you've used before

Import images, ZIPs, or whole folders, and each work folds into one group. Filter by tag, translation, model, or date. Select an image to copy its prompt or send it back to the workbench to keep editing. You can also multi-select and export as a ZIP to share. The export contains the original images, so the recipient can drag them in and see the prompts.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

# Daily Agent Benchmarks

**Live site: https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/** · [Archive](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/archive.html) · [Atom feed](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/feed.xml)

A daily, searchable list of new **AI / LLM agent benchmarks** on arXiv — web agents, GUI & computer-use agents, coding / SWE agents, tool use, multi-agent, embodied, and agent safety evaluations. Each paper gets a page with authors, abstract, field, citation count, and arXiv PDF / HTML links. Updated automatically every day via GitHub Actions.

Collects **Agent Benchmark** papers daily from [arXiv](https://arxiv.org) and organizes them into a static site deployable to GitHub Pages.

The site lists entries in reverse order by submission date: title, authors, abstract, category, and PDF / HTML links. Each day has a bilingual Chinese–English digest, and search runs in the browser using **BM25** ranking.

## What this repository does

1. **Runs once a day** (GitHub Actions, or manually locally) and calls the arXiv API.
2. **Keeps only Agent Benchmark papers**: first retrieves candidates with agent + benchmark–related queries, then filters by keyword scoring (LLM agent, web/GUI/coding agent, tool-use, computer-use, etc.). Excludes ordinary RL agents, reagents / pathogens, and other unrelated usages.
3. **Merges into the index** `docs/data/index.json`, grouped by `published` date.
4. **Generates the daily digest** (no paid model required): topic statistics plus the first sentence of the abstract of high-scoring papers, one each in Chinese and English.
5. **GitHub Pages** reads this JSON to render the pages. Search runs entirely in the browser and does not depend on a backend.

This API provides access to boatrace (motorboat racing) data. The data is published on GitHub Pages and provided in JSON format.

Supported period: **From 2026-01-01 onward**

```bash
https://boatraceopenapi.github.io/api/v1/YYYY/YYYYMMDD.json
```

- `YYYY` → year
- `YYYYMMDD` → year, month, and day
- Dates are based on Japan Standard Time (JST / UTC+9)

# Twitter (X) Intelligent Monitoring Bot 🤖

This is an industrial-grade tweet monitoring solution based on **Playwright Stealth** technology. By simulating real browser behavior, it bypasses blocking and bot detection, and pushes Twitter posts (including text, images, translations, and retweets) to your DingTalk in real time.

This project is designed for **GitHub Actions**, running fully automatically without your own server, and also supports local loop mode.

> 📖 **[Quick Start Guide](https://github.com/lixiansky/x2ding/blob/HEAD/DEPLOYMENT.md)** | 🔧 **[Cloudflare Worker Deployment Tutorial](https://github.com/lixiansky/x2ding/blob/HEAD/cloudflare-worker.js)**

## ✨ Core Highlights

*   **🛡️ Strong Anti-Detection**: Abandons traditional RSS interfaces in favor of **Playwright browser automation** + Stealth plugin. Automatically simulates human clicks to easily get past Nitter captchas and access restrictions.
*   **🌐 Automatic Translation & Cleanup**: 
    *   **One-click translation**: Integrates the Google Translate (GTX) interface to automatically translate tweets into Chinese for quick reading.
    *   **Smart cleaning**: Automatically identifies and removes decorative garbled characters in tweets (such as `€∋`), providing a clean reading experience.
*   **🖼️ Complete Image-Text Display**: 
    *   **Advanced image parsing**: Built-in complex URL restoration logic that recognizes and restores the original `pbs.twimg.com` address from Nitter's encrypted/proxy paths (such as the hex-encoded URLs used by `xcancel`).
    *   **Cloudflare image proxy**: Supports using Cloudflare Workers as an image proxy, ensuring DingTalk clients in mainland China can reliably load tweet images.
*   **🎥 Full Video Support**:
    *   **Automatic cover extraction**: Intelligently identifies video cover images and uploads them to an image host, ensuring they display properly in DingTalk.
    *   **Direct link**: Automatically attaches a video viewing link to messages for one-click playback.
*   **📡 Automatic Discovery of Available Nodes**: Integrates instance probing logic that periodically scans global Nitter nodes and dynamically selects the most stable and fastest "healthy instances."
*   **🧠 Smart Filtering Logic**: Automatically identifies and skips the blogger's **Pinned Tweets**, ensuring alerts are only sent for truly "fresh" posts.
*   **⚡ High-Frequency Monitoring**: Runs independently every 10 minutes, avoiding the cumulative delay problem of traditional looping tasks.

tianemon/EasyMint.description: Open-source desktop AI coding platform with built-in Pi Agent (pi-coding-agent) — a graphical AI programming assistant that lets non-technical users drive AI through the full software development flow (Electron)
tianemon/EasyMint.body:
[English](https://github.com/tianemon/EasyMint/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

---

## Positioning

Tell it what you want to do, clarify the features together with Mint, and advance design, development, and acceptance in the same desktop workspace. For interface projects that need a prototype, you can first choose a visual direction and try out interactive pages, then confirm the formal implementation.

EasyMint includes the [Pi Coding Agent](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) coding engine and supports macOS, Windows, and Linux. Beginners can advance step by step through project guidance, and developers can use it as a daily multi-agent programming workbench.

*In a project session, read the delivery conclusion first, and expand the thinking and tool process when needed. The screenshots currently use the Chinese interface; the app also supports English.*

## Design Philosophy: Let Ideas Become Discussable Projects First

Many software projects do not start from a complete set of requirements, but from a vague judgment: a process is too troublesome, a tool is missing a piece, or someone wants to build a small product for themselves. Once work actually begins, problems gradually emerge. How should features be split? What is the relationship between prototype, development, and acceptance? How should requirements be explained to AI so that it produces usable results?

EasyMint does not assume users have already mastered these. The four-step project definition expands “what I want to do” into constraints that can be selected and modified one by one: basic information sets the scope, the feature list helps break down capabilities, the visual direction turns aesthetic preferences into comparable pages, and delivery preferences clarify completeness, deployment method, AI capabilities, and cost boundaries. Users do not need to learn how to write prompts first, or understand the project structure first. They only need to make a judgment about the choices in front of them.

Once the project starts, Mint advances collaboration across implementation, explanation, and review. Users see how requirements turn into tasks, how tasks turn into prototypes and code, which constraints affected the result, and how the next round of changes can be expressed. EasyMint's goal is not to let people skip learning, but to let their first project get started and to gradually build, through real collaboration, an understanding of the software lifecycle and of how to communicate with AI.

## Quick Start

Go to [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tianemon/EasyMint/releases) to download the installer. Each installer exceeds Gitee's 100 MB single-attachment limit, so binaries are published only on GitHub Releases; the Gitee repository is a code mirror.

|---|---|
| macOS · Apple Silicon | `.dmg` |
| Windows · x64 | `.exe` installer or `.zip` portable version |

xianyu-sheng/Xenon.body:
# Xenon

> [!TIP]
> **The machine is only accountable for the process; semantic judgment is returned to you.** Tool calls enter the execution ledger (L0); `/evidence` currently displays the session audit chain, while the unified execution view for claim/plan/delivery is still converging (see #177). At the turn level there is only one blocking structural validation (L1); semantic issues do not block delivery, but are organized into a "manual verification checklist" delivered alongside the answer (L2).

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install from GitHub Releases (does not depend on PyPI)
pip install https://github.com/xianyu-sheng/Xenon/releases/download/v0.9.4/xenon_harness-0.9.4-py3-none-any.whl

xenon   # On first run, a setup wizard guides configuration (API key, model, reasoning engine)
```

> **Windows:** If you see `'xenon' 不是内部或外部命令` (the Chinese-locale Windows message meaning "'xenon' is not recognized as an internal or external command"), add the Scripts path printed by pip to PATH, or use `python -m xenon` directly (provided with release artifacts since v0.9.4). If mixing conda and a standalone Python, a dedicated venv is recommended: `python -m venv .venv`.

For more installation methods (source / uv / pipx), see [Installation](#安装).

## Evaluation

### Protocol (each item frozen, reproducible)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Protocol | **Fully blind test**: the official test patch is not applied during the solving stage, and the prompt does not contain FAIL_TO_PASS test names (`XENON_EVAL_APPLY_TEST_PATCH=0`, `XENON_EVAL_FAIL_HINT=0`) |
| Engine | **Single `react`**: not a union of multiple engines, and not best-of-N. This is a **framework A/B test**: with the engine fixed, differences can be attributed to the framework code itself |
| Model | `deepseek-v4-flash` official API, `--reasoning-effort off` |
| Budget | No step limit by default; LoopDetector + no-progress checkpoint + 1800s wall-clock fallback (`XENON_MAX_ITERATIONS` can explicitly set a cap) |
| Judging | Official `swebench` harness: clean container + model patch + official test patch; resolved only if all `FAIL_TO_PASS` pass and `PASS_TO_PASS` has no regressions |
| Denominator | `resolved / submitted(=30)`; empty patches are counted separately but **still count as unresolved** (conservative counting) |
| Repetition | **3 independent runs** per condition, averaged (per-run results all published; the range across single runs can reach 4 cases ≈ 13pp) |…
